content: Lightning BTC gift card products include: Azteco (code+redemption portal, no KYC, Lightning settlement), Lightning TipCards (fundable cards via LNURL-w, QR/print, track redemption status, withdraw remaining sats), LN Gift/Lnfi (multi-recipient, random/average split, 24h expiry, social share, URL/code claim), ZBD Vouchers (8-char code, API bulk creation, email distribution), btc-giftcard (partial spends, status lifecycle, BOLT11 invoice redemption). Common pattern: unique code/link → LNURL-withdraw → recipient's Lightning wallet.
